About

ABOUT US

Founded in 2007, The Maintainers is one of the ISO-certified affiliates of Al Jassra Group, a well-established Qatari holding company owned by Al Mana Family. We have gained a reputation for quality work and integrity amongst high-profile clients, positioning the company as the preferred supplier of choice in Facilities Management Services (FM) in both the private and public sectors. Today, we service over 30 industries and sectors in Qatar, and collectively manage over 1M SQM in client asset values.

Srvices

SERVICES PROVIDED

INTEGRATED FACILITIES MANAGEMENT

We maintain and operate buildings with a breadth of services ranging from HVAC and M&E to cleaning, security, and landscaping.

COMPUTER AIDED FACILITIES MANAGEMENT (CAFM) TECHNOLOGY

We combine business administration, behavioural science, architecture, and engineering concepts in one platform to optimise the functioning of the clients’ organisations.

BUILDING ASSET MANAGEMENT

We manage the clients' assets lifecycle, and help them make better procurement decisions that maximise equipment efficiency and reduce maintenance and spending costs.

SPECIALIST SERVICES

We offer a comprehensive suite of specialist technical services that serve the clients' unique needs and business objectives.

SUSTAINABILITY MANAGEMENT

We offer integrated and end-to-end sustainability services that are in line with the QNE Strategy framework to sustain a better environment for future generations.
